SQL_DOC.P_SQL: BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT QUOTATION_NO FROM PO_KEP_QUOTATION WHERE QUOTATION_NO = RTRIM($QUOTATION_NO$) AND QUOTATION_SEQ = RTRIM($QUOTATION_SEQ$) ) BEGIN INSERT INTO PO_KEP_QUOTATION ( QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, QUOTATION_DATE, BUYER_ITEM_ID, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, SUPPLIER_NAME, SUPPLIER_PERSON_NAME, SUPPLIER_TELNO, QUOTATION_PRICE, UNIT_PRICE, ADD_DATE, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_USER_NAME, REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE, REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, REQ_USER_TEL_NO, REQ_USER_MAIL, CLOSE_DATE, ITEM_QTY, REMARK ) VALUES ( $QUOTATION_NO$, $QUOTATION_SEQ$, $QUOTATION_DATE$, CAST(ISNULL($BUYER_ITEM_ID$,0) AS FLOAT), $BUYER_ITEM_NO$, $DESCRIPTION$, $UNIT_MEASURE$, $MAKER_NAME$, $SUPPLIER_NAME$, $SUPPLIER_PERSON_NAME$, $SUPPLIER_TELNO$, CAST(ISNULL($QUOTATION_PRICE$,0) AS FLOAT), CAST(ISNULL($UNIT_PRICE$,0) AS FLOAT), $ADD_DATE$, $REQ_USER_ID$, $REQ_USER_NAME$, $REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE$, $REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME$, $REQ_USER_TEL_NO$, $REQ_USER_MAIL$, $CLOSE_DATE$, CAST(ISNULL($ITEM_QTY$,0) AS FLOAT), $REMARK$ ) END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE PO_KEP_QUOTATION SET QUOTATION_DATE = $QUOTATION_DATE$, BUYER_ITEM_ID = CAST(ISNULL($BUYER_ITEM_ID$,0) AS FLOAT), BUYER_ITEM_NO = $BUYER_ITEM_NO$, DESCRIPTION = $DESCRIPTION$, UNIT_MEASURE = $UNIT_MEASURE$, MAKER_NAME = $MAKER_NAME$, SUPPLIER_NAME = $SUPPLIER_NAME$, SUPPLIER_PERSON_NAME = $SUPPLIER_PERSON_NAME$, SUPPLIER_TELNO = $SUPPLIER_TELNO$, QUOTATION_PRICE = CAST(ISNULL($QUOTATION_PRICE$,0) AS FLOAT), UNIT_PRICE = CAST(ISNULL($UNIT_PRICE$,0) AS FLOAT), ADD_DATE = $ADD_DATE$, REQ_USER_ID = $REQ_USER_ID$, REQ_USER_NAME = $REQ_USER_NAME$, REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE = $REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE$, REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME = $REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME$, REQ_USER_TEL_NO = $REQ_USER_TEL_NO$, REQ_USER_MAIL = $REQ_USER_MAIL$, CLOSE_DATE = $CLOSE_DATE$, ITEM_QTY = CAST(ISNULL($ITEM_QTY$,0) AS FLOAT), REMARK = $REMARK$ WHERE QUOTATION_NO = RTRIM($QUOTATION_NO$) AND QUOTATION_SEQ = RTRIM($QUOTATION_SEQ$) END END
